feedback: I am looking at the data, and it appears the symptoms have unfortunately intensified. Let's protect your skin barrier before anything else. Please consult a dermatologist to prevent any potential deep scarring, avoid all makeup and heavy products for at least one week, stop all brightening acids, as this might be irritation-induced hyperpigmentation, switch to a purely mineral-based SPF formula, and stay indoors as much as possible until the irritation subsides.
